title: From Rationale to Testable Hypotheses
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting from rationale to testable hypotheses to moderated usability test script with observation-to-revision trace, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Convert a design rationale into a falsifiable, directional hypothesis with an observable outcome and a stated threshold.
Distinguish a prediction the session can disconfirm from a goal it can only restate.
Ground each hypothesis in a named mechanism (for example, an extraneous-load reduction) so the test checks a theory, not a preference.
Decide when a result should revise the design and when it should revise the rationale.
